gaps.answer: invited him to join them for
gaps.lead: 'Would you like to join us for dinner?' they asked him.
gaps.explanation: invite somebody TO do something; pronouns shift in reporting.

gaps.lead: The doctor said that he should take a complete rest.
gaps.sentence: The doctor advised ___ a complete rest.
gaps.explanation: say + should → advise + object + to-infinitive: advised him to take.

gaps.lead: The instructions only made sense after she had read them twice.
gaps.sentence: The instructions ___ sense until she had read them twice.
gaps.explanation: made sense only after = didn't make sense until.

gaps.lead: 'I have never lied to the press,' the minister said.
gaps.explanation: deny + -ing (ever strengthens the denial): denied ever lying.

gaps.lead: She left early because she didn't want to miss the train.
gaps.explanation: so as not to / in order not to + infinitive.
last did X in (year) = haven't done X since (year).
